senses.gloss: (b. h.) to contract, go back; to leap (cmp. קָפַץ).
units: <cite ref="Taanit 27b">Taan. 27ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Megillah 22a">Meg. 22ᵃ</cite> <cite ref="D00166"><he>דּוֹלֵג</he></cite> the second reader goes back, i.e. takes up the last verse read by his predecessor.
<cite ref="Megillah 22a:10">Ib.</cite> <he>נִדְלוֹג</he> let us take up the last verse.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:9:2">Cant. R. to II, 9</cite> <he>מְדַלֵּג וכ׳</he> skips from mount &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Megillah 4:4">Meg. IV, 4</cite> <he>מְדַלְּגִין בנביא</he> in reading from the Prophets you may skip (read two portions separated in the text).
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 2">Num. R. s. 2</cite> <he>מד׳ מהלכה וכ׳</he> skips (digresses) from subject to subject.

<cite ref="Tosefta Demai 3:17">Tosef. Dem. III, 17</cite> charity collectors <he>מד׳ על פיתחיהן וכ׳</he> must skip the doors of (take no contributions from) those eating the fruits of the Sabbatical year; a. fr.
